statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); size=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.context_window_size // empty'); five=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); week=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); out="$model"; if [ -n "$used" ]; then out="$out | Context: $(printf '%.0f' "$used")% used"; if [ -n "$size" ]; then if [ "$size" -ge 1000000 ]; then out="$out of $(( size / 1000000 ))M"; else out="$out of $(( size / 1000 ))k"; fi; fi; fi; [ -n "$five" ] && out="$out | 5h: $(printf '%.0f' "$five")%"; [ -n "$week" ] && out="$out | 7d: $(printf '%.0f' "$week")%"; printf '%s' "$out"
